scope: Portfolio-level editorial summary of linked public source files; not independent commercial validation
disclaimer: Metrics apply to the documented synthetic or source datasets. No values are claimed as company revenue gained, risk avoided, or production accuracy.

entries.title: E-Commerce Sales & Customer Analytics
entries.question: Can transactional revenue and customer metrics be recomputed consistently after cleaning?
entries.test: Four business-rule tests plus cross-tool accounting reconciliation are reported.
entries.metricDetail: SQL/Python revenue and profit reconcile within INR 0.01 in a synthetic dataset of 72,388 original lines.
entries.tradeoff: Only Completed lines recognize revenue; this improves accounting consistency but depends on the simulated status model.
entries.limitations: No actual retailer data or independently measured revenue improvement. Power BI native refresh remains unverified.
entries.reviewNext: Run the existing pipeline and unit tests using the repository's documented Python setup, then compare SQL and Pandas totals.

entries.title: TransactionShield
entries.question: Can a scoring API expose fraud-risk recommendations without hiding severe model errors?
entries.test: Held-out synthetic evaluation uses 800 records with 21 labelled fraud events.
entries.metricDetail: Precision 0.0246, recall 0.1429, F1 0.0420; results are weak and do not support deployment.
entries.tradeoff: Validation F2 selected a recall-focused review threshold of 0.03, producing many false alarms.
entries.limitations: Not a production fraud detection system; real labels, calibration, drift monitoring and domain/security validation are missing.
entries.reviewNext: Inspect the evaluation record, rerun the repository's documented fast training script, and analyze the precision-recall tradeoff.

entries.title: DemandPilot AI
entries.question: Does a time-ordered forecasting pipeline outperform a naive seasonal benchmark?
entries.test: Validation and held-out one-step test WAPE are reported against a weekly seasonal naive baseline.
entries.metricDetail: Versus 29.012% for the seasonal naive baseline on simulated one-step held-out data.
entries.sample: 420 days of generated SKU-store sales; 8 products and 2 stores.
entries.tradeoff: Chronological validation reduces temporal leakage; recursive forecasting can compound error across the horizon.
entries.limitations: No rolling multi-step verification, calibrated confidence interval, or proven stockout reduction. The interval heuristic uses test residuals.
entries.reviewNext: Inspect the model card and compare lightGBM to seasonal naive under a proper rolling-origin multi-horizon experiment.

entries.title: EvidenceDesk Document Q&A
entries.question: Can a document question-answering workflow return traceable evidence and abstain when a source does not support the answer?
entries.test: 16 tests passed in the local recorded run; 30 authored fixture questions include five unsupported cases.
entries.metricDetail: 3/5 unsupported questions were correctly abstained; evidence-hit rate is not end-to-end generated answer accuracy.
entries.sample: Small authored, synthetic document question corpus.
entries.tradeoff: A local TF-IDF baseline is reproducible without relying on optional online LLM services.
entries.limitations: Live semantic/Groq mode, generated answer correctness, hosted multi-user security and fresh-machine installs remain unverified.
entries.reviewNext: Run the documented pytest and retrieval evaluator; separately test unsupported queries before enabling optional online modes.

entries.title: Zomato Insights Dashboard
entries.question: Can an interactive dashboard make restaurant composition, geography and cuisines easier to explore?
entries.test: README documents data-set KPIs and visualization components. No independently reproduced public browser or PBIX render was verified.
entries.metricDetail: Also 250 cuisines, 15 countries, 141 cities, and average rating 2.89, reported in the project README.
entries.sample: Restaurant-level workbook referenced by the Power BI case study.
entries.tradeoff: Filters and KPI cards enable contextual exploration but must not be mistaken for causally proven commercial outcomes.
entries.limitations: Native PBIX and workbook files are described in source material; direct public binary download and refresh are not independently verified.
entries.reviewNext: Validate the source workbook's row counts and data schema in Power BI Desktop, then compare published measures against the README.
